rows.note: This is the all-purpose rendering for a person who rides a horse, bicycle, or motorbike; use 騎 for an animal or bicycle and 揸 for a motor vehicle.

example.english: I am a rider who rides a bicycle.
example.jyutping: ngo5 hai6 jat1 go3 ke4 daan1 ce1 ge3 jan4

rows.note: Use this for someone travelling in a vehicle as a passenger rather than operating it.

example.english: When I took the minibus, the rider slept the whole way.
example.traditional: 我坐小巴嗰陣，個乘客一路瞓覺。
example.jyutping: ngo5 co5 siu2 baa1 go2 zan6 go3 sing4 haak3 jat1 lou6 fan3 gaau3

rows.note: Use this specifically for a motorcycle enthusiast or member of a motorcycle-riding community, not just any person riding a vehicle.

example.english: This rider is a member of our motorcycle club.
example.traditional: 呢位電單車友係我哋車會會員。
example.jyutping: ni1 wai6 din6 daan1 ce1 jau5 hai6 ngo5 dei6 ce1 wui2 wui2 jyun4
